questions.questionText: The meeting starts ___ nine o’clock.
questions.explanation: At dùng với giờ cụ thể.

questions.questionText: Please submit the report ___ Friday.
questions.explanation: By chỉ hạn chót.

questions.questionText: All employees must wear ___ identification badges.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ cần tính từ sở hữu their.

questions.questionText: The new software is ___ than the previous version.
questions.explanation: Than đi với dạng so sánh hơn.

questions.questionText: Ms. Lee has worked here ___ 2020.
questions.explanation: Since đi với mốc thời gian.

questions.questionText: The package will ___ tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Sau will là động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.questionText: We look forward to ___ you at the conference.
questions.explanation: Look forward to đi với V-ing.

questions.questionText: The manager spoke ___ about the new policy.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa động từ spoke.

questions.questionText: ___ the heavy rain, the delivery arrived on time.
questions.explanation: Despite đi trước cụm danh từ.

questions.questionText: A receipt is required ___ you request a refund.
questions.explanation: When nối mệnh đề thời gian.

questions.questionText: The documents ___ by the supervisor yesterday.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ bị động: were + phân từ.

questions.questionText: Please contact us if you need ___ information.
questions.explanation: Tính từ additional bổ nghĩa information.

questions.questionText: This room is large ___ for twenty participants.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc adjective + enough.

questions.questionText: The office is closed ___ public holidays.
questions.explanation: On dùng với ngày.

questions.questionText: Neither the printer nor the scanners ___ working.
questions.explanation: Động từ hòa hợp với chủ ngữ gần nhất scanners.

questions.questionText: We have ___ completed the safety inspection.
questions.explanation: Already dùng trong câu khẳng định hoàn thành.

questions.questionText: The candidate has extensive ___ in accounting.
questions.explanation: Experience ở đây là danh từ không đếm được.

questions.questionText: The presentation was postponed ___ the speaker was ill.
questions.explanation: Because đứng trước mệnh đề.

questions.questionText: Please keep the entrance ___ at all times.
questions.explanation: Keep + tân ngữ + tính từ.

questions.questionText: The company plans ___ a new branch.
questions.explanation: Plan đi với to-infinitive.

questions.questionText: Our sales increased ___ fifteen percent.
questions.explanation: By chỉ mức tăng.

questions.questionText: The assistant prepared the slides ___.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa prepared.

questions.questionText: The engineer ___ designed the system will lead the training.
questions.explanation: Who làm chủ ngữ chỉ người.

questions.questionText: There are only a ___ seats available.
questions.explanation: A few đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

questions.questionText: The invoice must be paid ___ thirty days.
questions.explanation: Within chỉ khoảng thời hạn.

questions.questionText: If the weather improves, we ___ the event outdoors.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 1: if hiện tại, will + V.

questions.questionText: The customer asked ___ the warranty covered repairs.
questions.explanation: Whether mở mệnh đề nghi vấn gián tiếp.

questions.questionText: This is the ___ route to the airport.
questions.explanation: The đi với dạng so sánh nhất.

questions.questionText: The team is responsible ___ maintaining the equipment.
questions.explanation: Responsible for + V-ing.

questions.questionText: The instructions should be read before ___ the machine.
questions.explanation: Giới từ before đi với V-ing.
